Verified live: postgres database is already 22GB with process_exec_events and runtime_events at 11GB each and growing unbounded. This is a real gap for both the research protocol (uncontrolled artifact growth) and for production deployment (unbounded disk use, eventual outage). Must be fixed before confirmatory collection at full scale (200 trials) or before any real deployment.

notes: 6 of 7 items pass with concrete evidence (code + tests), not just claims. Retention is a genuine unaddressed gap, verified against the live running system, not hypothetical. Recommend: add a retention/pruning policy (age-based or size-based) for process_exec_events/runtime_events before scaling confirmatory collection past pilot volume, and before any production deployment.
